description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies how many days worth of log files to keep before being cleaned up.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Logging\LogFileKeepingPeriod
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 0, Max = 180
